                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Would you please



                 recognize Senator Saland.



                            THE PRESIDENT:    Senator Saland.



                            SENATOR SALAND:    Thank you, Madam



                 President.



                            I rise for purposes of an



                 introduction.  I'm rather privileged to stand



                 here today in the Senate chamber and to



                 introduce to you a group of Nigerian



                 legislators and staff.  They've obviously



                 traveled quite some distance to get here, six



                 staff members and six legislators from -



                            THE PRESIDENT:    Excuse us,



                 Senator Saland.  You may proceed.



                            SENATOR SALAND:    Thank you, Madam



                 President.



                            -- six staff members and six



                 legislators from six of the Nigerian states.



                            They are here as part of an



                 international program which is being conducted



                 by the National Conference of State



                 Legislatures, of which I currently serve as











                                                        3188







                 the president.



                            I've had the opportunity to meet



                 with them; they have met with some members of



                 our Senate staff.  They have had the



                 opportunity to meet with the Deputy Minority



                 Leader, Senator Paterson.



                            And I would like to, at least



                 within their ranks, recognize, as we like to



                 do, the speaker from the Plateau State House



                 of Assembly, Speaker Simon Lalong, as well as



                 all of the other members of their delegation.



                            (Applause.)



                            SENATOR SALAND:    They are



                 accompanied by Patrick McCorry, of the



                 International Programs component of NCSL.



                            And tomorrow our colleagues in the



                 Assembly will also be going through a number



                 of processes and issues with them as we in the



                 Senate have today.



                            Thank you, Madam President.



                            THE PRESIDENT:    Senator Paterson.



                            SENATOR PATERSON:    Madam



                 President, I wanted to thank Senator Saland



                 for extending to me the opportunity to meet



                 with this great delegation from the different











                                                        3189







                 states of Nigeria.



                            This is a country that meant a lot



                 to me when I was 9 years old.  I wrote a



                 report about Nigeria in the fourth grade when,



                 at the time, the president's name was Abubakar



                 Balewa.



                            And from that time, this country's



                 great contribution to the economic development



                 and cultural history of the African continent



                 is certainly regaled and was best represented



                 by their presence here today.



                            And again, along with Senator



                 Saland, we welcome them and hope they enjoy



                 their visit until they leave on Thursday.



                            And who knows, maybe in the



                 upcoming World Cup tournament we'll be rooting



                 for the Super Eagles.



                            Thank you.



                            THE PRESIDENT:    Thank you,



                 Senators.



                            On behalf of the Senate, and as its



                 president, I want to extend to you a very warm



                 welcome.  We're very honored to have you here.



                 May you have an enjoyable, productive and



                 educational -- in a positive way -- trip here.
